mentions.name: Zero-dependency Rust web app platform
mentions.description: A web app platform written in Rust with a primary focus on zero-dependency apps, using Pingora as a forward and reverse proxy. Hosting is targeted at Hetzner with Cloudflare for DNS. Its zero-dependency approach is designed to avoid Rust's long compile times by making compiles fast.
mentions.problem: Rust's long compile times; zero dependencies make for fast compiles.
mentions.source_excerpt: A web app platform written in Rust with the primary focus on zero-dependency apps and using Pingora as a forward and reverse proxy. Targeting Hetzner for hosting and Cloudflare for DNS. I love Rust but don’t like the long compile times which led me down this rabbit hole (zero dependencies make for fast compiles).
